fact: Finance Minister Mohamed Maait says the e-payment service for government employees' payrolls grew 24% to EGP 299.4 billion in July 2023 to May 2024.

Egypt's finance minister said electronic payment of state employees' salaries reached EGP 299.4 billion in July 2023 to May 2024, up 24% on the year before, through the Ministry of Finance's government e-payment and collection centre.
Egypt's Ministry of Social Solidarity pays Takaful and Karama cash support monthly into a mobile wallet on request, alongside payment through Meeza cards and the post.
Egypt's social solidarity ministry disbursed Takaful and Karama cash support from 15 August 2024 to 5.2 million families, including holders of Meeza bank cards withdrawing at bank ATMs.

Egypt's Ministry of Social Solidarity says June 2026 Takaful and Karama cash assistance, over EGP 4 billion for 4.7 million families, is paid electronically through bank ATMs, Nasser Social Bank branches, Fawry outlets and Meeza cards.
